bulletin.evening: Conditions are favourable for further withdrawal from remaining parts of Punjab, Haryana Chandigarh Delhi, some more parts of Rajasthan and some parts of Saurashtra & Kutch, Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh during next 2 3 days.

met_analysis:
Conditions are favourable for further withdrawal from remaining parts of Punjab, Haryana-Chandigarh-Delhi, some more parts of Rajasthan and some parts of Saurashtra & Kutch, Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh during next 2-3 days.
The Well-marked Low Pressure area over westcentral & adjoining eastcentral Bay of Bengal persists over the same region at 1430 hrs IST of today, the 21th September, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level. It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify into a depression over Westcentral Bay of Bengal during next 24 hrs and into a deep depression over Westcentral & adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal during subsequent 24 hrs. Continuing to move west-northwestwards it is very likely to reach near north Andhra Pradesh - South Odisha coasts around morning of 23rd September 2026.
The North-South trough from North Bay of Bengal to the cyclonic circulation associated with the Well- marked Low Pressure area and extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from the centre of the cyclonic circulation associated with the Well-marked Low Pressure area to North Andaman Sea at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Tamil Nadu & neighbourhoodbetween 4.5 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from southeast Arabian sea to the cyclonic circulation associated with the Well-marked Low Pressure area across Kerala, Tamil Nadu and southwest Bay of Bengal through the centre of the above cyclonic circulation over central Tamil Nadu & neighbourhoodbetween 5.8 &7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Eastcentral & adjoining Northeast Arabian Sea between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Jammu and neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
